newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$3.00/cubic metre or C$0.48/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:
Edmonton light sweet C$207.00/cubic metre, or C$32.91/barrel
Cromer light sour C$201.00/cubic metre, or C$31.96/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$168.00/cubic metre, or C$26.71/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$176.00/cubic metre, or C$27.98/barrel
